item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 13 #VISPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 13 #VISPRSD
Issued at 10:18 PM 14 August 2026

Moderate to Heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over #Palawan(SanVicente and PuertoPrincesaCity) within the next 1 to 2 hours.

The above conditions are being experienced in #Palawan(Dumaran, Araceli, Roxas, Culion, Busuanga, Coron), #OccidentalMindoro(Sablayan, Calintaan, Rizal and SanJose) which may persist within 1 to 2 hours and may affect nearby areas.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides. Keep monitoring for updates.
